parts.name: Connector
parts.Basic_description: This is the connector hinge of the laptop, made of aluminum alloy, connecting the screen and base sides.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the screen to rotate relative to the base, enabling the laptop to open and close smoothly.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around a fixed axis, providing angular motion between the screen and base.

parts.name: Screen Side
parts.Basic_description: This is the screen side of the laptop, made of glass and plastic frame, forming the display area.
parts.Functional_description: It displays visual output from the computer, serving as the main interface for user interaction.
parts.Movement_description: It moves as a single rigid body when the laptop is opened or closed, pivoting around the connector.

parts.name: Base Side
parts.Basic_description: This is the base side of the laptop, made of aluminum alloy, housing the keyboard, touchpad, and internal components.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the main hardware components and provides the primary interface for typing and control.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during normal use, serving as the stable foundation of the laptop.

parts.name: Decoration (Other)
parts.Basic_description: This is a decorative or branding element on the laptop, made of plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It serves aesthetic and branding purposes, sometimes covering screws or seams.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during laptop operation.
